problems.detail: @dsh-triage/core@0.3.0, dsh-triage@0.3.0, @dsh-triage/signals@0.3.0, @dsh-triage/probe@0.3.0 已经在 registry 上了；再次发布会报 cannot publish over the previously published versions
problems.fix: 先把四个包的 version 一起 bump（如 0.3.1），或者这版已经发好了：直接跑 `node scripts/record_publish.mjs --version 0.3.0` 取证（`--stamp` 可省，默认当前时间；别把 `<ISO>` 原样粘进 PowerShell，`<` 是保留符）

notes: workspace: protocol: 5 dep(s), publish goes through pnpm (rewritten)
limits: this is the pre-publish check, not the release: it says nothing about the bytes a registry would serve (that is `record_publish`)
a registry it could not reach is reported as a note, never as a pass
